study type: Retrospective Cohort Study with a prospective subgroup follow-up
cohort: 3383 neonates (6766 hips) who underwent hip ultrasound screening in Germany between 2007 and 2022.
finding: This study provides reference values for early DDH screening (mean alpha angle 61.2deg, mean beta angle 70.8deg) and confirms abnormal birth presentation (OR = 3.09) and female sex (OR = 3.77) as relevant risk factors for DDH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not found to be associated with Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH).
